scope: This is a quantitative limitation of two specified witnesses paired with the single explicit KG 4x5 PPT source R. It is NOT a statement about other witnesses, other sources, or nonexistence of any 4x4 PPT Schmidt-number-three state. The second witness's 2-block positivity is still unproved.
statement: Let Q_W(T)=Tr[W(I_4 tensor T)R(I_4 tensor T)^*] for T in C^(5 x 5), and let P_K be the projector onto ker R. For all T, Q_(P_K)(T)>=(1/2)||T-(Tr T/5)I_5||_F^2. Hence if rank(T)<=4, Q_(P_K)(T)>=(1/10)||T||_F^2. For the explicit integer detector W_int=18*10^11 P_K+18P_K0-58[A] in frontier-20261029-kg-explicit-rational-2positive-detector-v1.json, this gives Q_(W_int)(T)>=(18*10^10-348)||T||_F^2>0 for all nonzero rank<=4 T. For the distinct earlier unverified W_cand=300 P_K+(3/10)([B]+[D]+[G]+[I])-(3/5)[A]+(3/100)I, it gives Q_(W_cand)(T)>=(132/5)||T||_F^2>0 for all nonzero rank<=4 T. Neither specified pairing can satisfy the rank<=4 filter-lift condition on R.
exact_link_matrix: Index T by (p,q) and let U_(j,pq)=(I_4 tensor |p><q|)v_j, with the nine weighted source vectors and weights as in the detector packet. Construct the integer matrix (L6)_(pq,rs)=sum_j w_j <U_(j,pq),6 P_K U_(j,rs)>. Then t^*L6 t=6 Q_(P_K)(T). Let u=vec(I_5). The exact integer/Fraction checker constructs the 25x25 matrix H=5L6-15I_25+3[u], verifies H is PSD of rank 24 by exact Schur pivots, and verifies L6*u=0. Therefore L6>=3(I_25-[u]/5), establishing the all-T link gap. This matrix check is exact arithmetic, not proof-assistant verification.
rank_and_negative_term_bounds: If rank(T)<=4, choose its range projection P, so PT=T and |Tr T|=|Tr(P T)|<=||P||_F||T||_F<=2||T||_F. Hence ||T-(Tr T/5)I||_F^2=||T||_F^2-|Tr T|^2/5>=||T||_F^2/5. The source eigenvalues are 3,2,2,6,6,3,3,3,3, so 0<=R<=6I. With A=|00>+|11>+|22>, Q_[A](T)=<(I tensor T)^* A|R|(I tensor T)^* A> <=6 sum_(i=0)^2 ||T^*|i>||^2<=6||T||_F^2. Drop all positive witness terms except P_K and use these two inequalities to get both displayed strict margins.
